Thank you again. Onwards and upwards 🚀

If someone is ALWAYS caught up in some sort of drama then it's not because of everybody else.

People never fully recovered from the pandemic response.

Not just in terms of some people's health, but the economy, social and institutional trust, and overall mental wellbeing.

No questions were answered and there was never any accountability. So the loop is still open.

A significant % of Gen Z get 'anxiety' from talking on the phone, sustaining eye contact, cooking, driving, and other basic, everyday tasks.

Those who don't fall into this category will completely dominate those who do. They might end up being the most bifurcated generation.
